items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: A friend of mine, y'know I knew, she used to be a barmaid, so I knew her... Her name was Jessie.

ctx.x: "You gotta get outa here. You too young to be in here. You momma don't know you down here."

So I get kicked out but I never gave up. I used to go back down to the clubs. So after I started workin' with the I-talians, I was ... Tendin' to help the lady washin' the glass. I wasn't tendin' no bar. A friend of mine, y'know I knew, she used to be a barmaid, so I knew her, so she let me come in there.
